name: kensio
description: Claude Code skills from Kensio Software — reusable, opinionated ways of working, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: isolated-testing-style
plugins.description: An opinionated testing style: real collaborators through simulation instead of stubs, isolation from randomised data instead of setup and teardown, and assertions on behaviour instead of call counts.

plugins.name: yulin-aws-simulation
plugins.description: How to test AWS code well with the @kensio/yulin in-process simulator, covering SDK interception, deploying real synthesized CloudFormation templates, and handling what the simulator refuses.

plugins.name: part-factory-test-data
plugins.description: How to build test data with @kensio/part-factory, covering which factory to reach for, when a mapped factory earns its place, and why factories belong beside the type they construct.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: A minimal example skill that demonstrates the shape of a Kensio plugin. Use it to verify that the marketplace is wired up correctly.

plugins.name: skill-template
plugins.description: A copy-and-edit starting point for writing a new Claude Code skill, covering SKILL.md frontmatter, description wording, and progressive disclosure.
